Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: Matkakirja game loading image, original illustrative camera-like photo. Scene: an orbital rocket liftoff on the low flat coastal launch platform at Andøya near Nordmela, northern Norway, about69.3N. Viewed from a safe offshore distance with Norwegian Sea water in the foreground, flat rocky-green coastal strip in the middle distance, and the island’s steep green and gray rocky fells behind. This is a broad introduction to the coastal place and landscape. Natural northern evening light with a low warm sun filtering through broken clouds; muted believable colors and natural atmospheric haze. A bright but physically plausible exhaust flame illuminates the underside of thick white billowing exhaust/steam spreading laterally around the launch platform. One modest generic service tower beside the platform. The rocket has only just cleared the launch platform by a few metres, ascending absolutely vertically. Its whole fuselage occupies about20percent of the full image HEIGHT; do not count the flame/steam in that body-size measure. The launcher is an intentionally generic slender white two-stage orbital rocket with a simple white nose and subtle stage joint; not a recognizable actual company’s launcher. Rocket, flame and entire spreading cloud must be clearly visible, believable scale and gravity. Photorealistic real-camera documentary look, natural microtextures of water, rock, grass and vapor, no repeating artificial patterns, no illustration brushwork, no CG/render look, no HDR or oversaturation, no exaggerated cinematic orange/teal grading. No close people, no recognizable faces, no company vehicle markings, no logos, no flags, no numbers or writing ANYWHERE, no signs, no watermark or decorative border. Do not reproduce any company rocket, especially not Isar Aerospace Spectrum. No extra rocket, aircraft, astronauts or spacecraft. Opaque PNG, naturally sRGB. Do not place the required caption or AI disclosure in the visible pixels; those are metadata added later.
Portrait canvas EXACTLY1024x1536. Central rocket and rising cloud. Plenty of quiet open sky in upper third for game UI and coastal landscape below. Keep the entire rocket body, exhaust flame and substantial launch-platform/white cloud within that central horizontal band, roughly rocket top y600 and bodybase y900, with platform/cloud around y1000; sea and fells still support that crop. The full portrait retains calm sky above and water/shore below. No UI is actually drawn.

QA.reason: Hyväksytty vain Päätoimittajalle toimitettavaksi vertailuehdokkaaksi. Koko natiivi ja keskeltä otettu 1024×768-diagnostiikkarajaus katsottu: raketti, liekki, pilvi, ranta, meri ja tunturit säilyvät rajauksessa; ylhäällä on rauhallista UI-tilaa. Valo ja pintatekstuurit näyttävät luonnollisilta, eikä kuvassa havaittu tekstiä, logoja, lippuja, kasvoja tai vesileimaa. Ohjepoikkeama: raketin runko on noin 11 prosenttia koko kuvan korkeudesta (keskirajauksessa noin 22 prosenttia), tavoite oli noin 20 prosenttia koko kuvasta. Raketti on jo selvästi huoltotornin yläpuolella, joten nousuhetki näyttää myöhemmältä kuin juuri alustalta irtoaminen. Nämä poikkeamat on hyväksyttävä erikseen ennen käyttöä; tämä QA ei ole täysi ohjeenmukaisuuden, todellisen laukaisupaikan geometrian tai omistajan valinnan vahvistus.
